verdict.rationale: The dots docs say you can connect apps such as email, calendar and files during setup or add them later, naming Gmail, Google Drive and GitHub. Adding third-party connectors is therefore a documented first-party capability. There is no evidence of a browsable directory or marketplace of apps, and only a few named connectors appear. Missing for 10: a documented browsable app/connector directory, the breadth of the third-party catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration of the add-connector flow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: Connect apps such as email, calendar, and files, or skip this step and add them later.
connect Gmail to find relevant email, Google Drive to read and update documents, or GitHub to investigate an issue and prepare a pull request.
